note: FR-21 ablations: each variant flips one JobConfig switch of the agent as compared (governor off; 'governor-on' is deployment behaviour). Same segmenter and fixed costs for all; ratio_vs_full is a paired bootstrap over images; chance_recall is each variant's own boxes at random places.

synth200.coupling: no-uncertainty and no-seed lower every score, so the stop floor (eps x v0) also ends their jobs sooner: their ratio_vs_full mixes the term's effect on where the agent looks with a smaller pixel spend (see pixels_frac and halt_causes). The '+no-floor' rows remove the floor as well; their ratio_vs_ref, against no-floor, is the term's effect on gaze order alone.
random_order: At a 30% pixel cap, random order found 0.46-0.48 of the ground-truth boxes over seeds 0-2 and the full agent 0.48. None of the 11 variant-vs-full CIs at this cap is corrected for multiple comparisons.
